raw_html: [[Slowburst| Slowburst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Slowburst| Slowburst]]:''' This weapon has an image of a snail worked into its hilt or grip, and it feels cold to the touch. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target is [[slow]]ed for 30 seconds. A DC 15 [[Will save]] negates this effect.
